Location: Turkey (Remote)

Cambly is one of the largest online English language platforms in the world, backed by top-tier investors like Bessemer and Benchmark. We help thousands of people improve their English and proudly partner with hundreds of the world’s most prestigious companies to empower their teams with language skills for global success.

We're looking for highly motivated, organized, and results-driven SDRs to be a core part of our 2026 success story and beyond in the dynamic Turkish B2B market.

Why Join Cambly?

Your experience at Cambly will be a true career accelerator where you'll gain crucial skills and build an invaluable network.

  • High-Impact Role: You'll be tackling a critical challenge for Learning & Development teams making a tangible difference in organizational success.

  • Career Growth: Work directly with experienced sales leaders and utilize the latest sales technology.

  • Premium Network: Build relationships and network with prestigious HR and procurement teams across the Turkish market.

  • Culture: An employee-first working culture focused on results, no unnecessary stress or nonsense.

The Role

As our SDR, you'll play the crucial role of breaking into new accounts and fostering relationships within our target customer segments in Turkey. You understand that this is one of the most vital roles in the company, directly impacting the bottom line by creating the initial pipeline. Day-to-day, you'll collaborate closely with the wider sales team, conduct market research, and qualify leads by learning about their approach to language education.

Responsibilities

  • Drive New Business Growth: Execute targeted, outbound prospecting and account penetration strategies to generate qualified sales opportunities.

  • Qualify and Nurture Leads: Engage and develop leads (inbound and outbound) through multi-channel outreach including social selling, cold calls, email sequences, and event follow-up.

  • Master the Lead Lifecycle: Identify and develop an in-depth understanding of the lead generation process, supporting marketing activities and ensuring a seamless, qualified handoff to an Account Executive.

  • Diligently Follow Up: Conduct persistent follow-up calls and emails until meetings are successfully set.

  • Contribute to Sales Strategy: Share valuable market insights and help build out our world-class Sales Playbook and Tech Stack by learning from our well-seasoned sales team.

Qualifications

Must-Haves

  • Native in Turkish and fully proficient in English (C1/C2 level) for clear business communication.

  • 2 years of proven experience in a Sales Development, BDR, or similar outbound commercial role.

  • Proven track record of achieving and exceeding targets in a quota-carrying role.

  • Experience working directly with B2B clients in the Turkish market.

  • Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills. You have a way with words and can write compelling email copy and sequence campaigns that convert.

  • Experience with CRM systems and sales engagement tools

  • Experience working with HR & Learning Development teams or for a learning, e-learning, HR software, or wellbeing company.

Skills & Mindset

  • A self-motivated, results-driven, and entrepreneurial spirit with a strong growth mindset.

  • Strong organizational and time management skills; ability to work autonomously and self-source solutions.

  • Active relationship builder who can collaborate effectively with internal and external teams to consistently improve processes and communication.

  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, dynamic, and remote team environment.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Prior experience working at a fast-growing startup.

  • Previous experience working in a remote & distributed team.

Some things you will enjoy

  • Financial & Growth: Competitive salary, a fair commission system, and a professional development budget.

  • Time & Flexibility: Remote work, and paid time off available from your first month.

  • Comprehensive Care: Supplementary private health insurance provided.

  • Mental Health: Access to Modern Health, offering 6 free coaching and 6 free therapy sessions.

  • Allowances: Dedicated lunch and internet allowances.

  • Team: A truly global team.

Interested? Applying is simple: just click 'Apply' and upload your CV to get started.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer
jobs.description: STAFF SOFTWARE ENGINEER About Cambly: Our mission is to bring high-quality English education to every English learner in the world at the touch of a button. Think of us as the Airbnb that matches English students with English tutors. Come help us build the world's largest English learning marketplace and school. We're looking for a Staff Software Engineer to own the technical direction of the products we ship. You'll be a senior technical owner on a fast-moving engineering team of around 15 engineers: backend-strong, comfortable working across the stack, and accountable for taking products from design through launch. You'll work closely with product managers, designers, and engineers, and you'll set the bar for how the team builds. We're bringing AI to language learning in a way that strengthens what makes Cambly work: real tutors and real human connection. And we build AI-first: implementation is delegated to AI coding tools so engineers spend their time on the decisions, design, and review that actually shape the product. That's how you work too. Our frontend is built on Next.js, React, and TypeScript. Our backend is built with Python (Flask and FastAPI) on AWS with MongoDB. YOU WILL - Own the product platform. Lead the design and delivery of our backend systems: APIs, data models, and services, and be accountable for them working in production. - Make the hard calls. Own the judgment that shapes product work, including how we model the domain and when to build for scale and extensibility versus building quickly for fast learnings. - Ship end to end. Take products from technical design through launch, and own major initiatives across the team. - Work across the stack. Pick up frontend, mobile, and data work outside your core when a product needs it, using AI to be effective in areas where you aren't the resident expert. - Set how we build. Raise the technical bar through architecture, reviews, and good practices, and turn the AI workflows that work into practices the rest of the team adopts. - Grow the team. Mentor engineers, review their work, and help raise the standard of everyone around you. WORK ON PROJECTS LIKE - Owning the platform behind a new AI-forward learning experience that generates personalized activities for each learner, and shaping it as we learn what works. - Designing the backend systems and data models that hold up as an AI-forward product grows. - Building post-lesson activities curated to each learner's areas for improvement. ABOUT YOU - 7+ years of engineering experience, with a track record of owning systems and leading them to production. - Deep backend ability: API design, data modeling, and production systems that hold up at scale. - You build AI-first. Directing AI coding tools to do the implementation, and spending your own time on decisions and review, is already how you work, not something you're curious to try. - You own your work and have the technical judgment to make the calls that come with it, including when to invest in scale and extensibility and when to optimize for speed and learning. - Comfortable working outside your core. You'd rather pick up unfamiliar parts of the stack and ship than wait for a specialist. - A product mindset. You care about shipping things learners actually use. - A clear communicator who can explain technical trade-offs to engineers and non-engineers alike. LIFE AT CAMBLY INCLUDES - $60M VC backed. Check out why Bessemer https://www.bvp.com/news/our-investment-in-cambly invested in us. - Hybrid first company. Office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday. - Daily catered lunch. - 100% of medical, dental, and vision paid, along with 401k matching up to 4%. - Maternity and paternity paid leave. - 20 days of PTO, 9 days of sick leave, 10 company holidays, plus an end-of-year shutdown. - Helping people around the world unlock economic opportunities by learning English. COMPENSATION This role is based in the San Francisco Bay Area, and the expected base salary range for this position is shown below. The actual base pay depends on job-related factors such as professional background, training, work experience, business needs, and market demand, so in some circumstances the actual salary could fall outside this range. This pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. All full-time employees are also eligible for equity compensation and for benefits. $200,000 - $230,000 USD Base Salary plus pre-IPO stock options. EQUAL OPPORTUNITY We are proud to be a highly inclusive company and an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We believe that in order to thrive, businesses need a diverse team and leadership. We welcome every background, identity, ability, and mindset to join us on our mission to make high-quality English education available to all. Everyone is welcome here.

We're looking for a Staff Software Engineer to own the technical direction of the products we ship. You'll be a senior technical owner on a fast-moving engineering team of around 15 engineers: backend-strong, comfortable working across the stack, and accountable for taking products from design through launch. You'll work closely with product managers, designers, and engineers, and you'll set the bar for how the team builds.

We're bringing AI to language learning in a way that strengthens what makes Cambly work: real tutors and real human connection. And we build AI-first: implementation is delegated to AI coding tools so engineers spend their time on the decisions, design, and review that actually shape the product. That's how you work too.

Our frontend is built on Next.js, React, and TypeScript. Our backend is built with Python (Flask and FastAPI) on AWS with MongoDB.

You will

  • Own the product platform. Lead the design and delivery of our backend systems: APIs, data models, and services, and be accountable for them working in production.

  • Make the hard calls. Own the judgment that shapes product work, including how we model the domain and when to build for scale and extensibility versus building quickly for fast learnings.

  • Ship end to end. Take products from technical design through launch, and own major initiatives across the team.

  • Work across the stack. Pick up frontend, mobile, and data work outside your core when a product needs it, using AI to be effective in areas where you aren't the resident expert.

  • Set how we build. Raise the technical bar through architecture, reviews, and good practices, and turn the AI workflows that work into practices the rest of the team adopts.

  • Grow the team. Mentor engineers, review their work, and help raise the standard of everyone around you.

Work on projects like

  • Owning the platform behind a new AI-forward learning experience that generates personalized activities for each learner, and shaping it as we learn what works.

  • Designing the backend systems and data models that hold up as an AI-forward product grows.

  • Building post-lesson activities curated to each learner's areas for improvement.

About you

  • 7+ years of engineering experience, with a track record of owning systems and leading them to production.

  • Deep backend ability: API design, data modeling, and production systems that hold up at scale.

  • You build AI-first. Directing AI coding tools to do the implementation, and spending your own time on decisions and review, is already how you work, not something you're curious to try.

  • You own your work and have the technical judgment to make the calls that come with it, including when to invest in scale and extensibility and when to optimize for speed and learning.

  • Comfortable working outside your core. You'd rather pick up unfamiliar parts of the stack and ship than wait for a specialist.

  • A product mindset. You care about shipping things learners actually use.

  • A clear communicator who can explain technical trade-offs to engineers and non-engineers alike.

Life at Cambly includes

  • $60M VC backed. Check out why Bessemer invested in us.

  • Hybrid first company. Office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday.

  • Daily catered lunch.

  • 100% of medical, dental, and vision paid, along with 401k matching up to 4%.

  • Maternity and paternity paid leave.

  • 20 days of PTO, 9 days of sick leave, 10 company holidays, plus an end-of-year shutdown.

  • Helping people around the world unlock economic opportunities by learning English.

Compensation

This role is based in the San Francisco Bay Area, and the expected base salary range for this position is shown below. The actual base pay depends on job-related factors such as professional background, training, work experience, business needs, and market demand, so in some circumstances the actual salary could fall outside this range. This pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. All full-time employees are also eligible for equity compensation and for benefits.

$200,000 - $230,000 USD Base Salary plus pre-IPO stock options.


Equal opportunity

We are proud to be a highly inclusive company and an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We believe that in order to thrive, businesses need a diverse team and leadership. We welcome every background, identity, ability, and mindset to join us on our mission to make high-quality English education available to all. Everyone is welcome here.

jobs.title: Sales Director, APAC (Sales & Marketing)
jobs.description: About the Role We are at the early stage of building our B2B business across Asia, and we are looking for a senior leader to own and grow the region. This is an active leadership role: you will build the regional growth plan and personally drive it across Japan, China, and Korea. This is a rare opportunity to shape a high-potential market from the ground up — defining the strategy, opening new markets, and bringing an established network of buyer relationships that will accelerate our growth from day one. What You'll Do - Own the growth strategy and revenue plan for the APAC region (Japan, China, and Korea). - Lead and develop both sales and marketing efforts across the region — not maintaining, but actively growing. - Sell directly: this is a hands-on role where you are expected to prospect, build relationships, and close at a senior level using your own network and attending industry events and conferences with your team. - Launch and develop new markets across APAC - Build and manage the regional team including account executives, account managers and B2B Marketing specialists as the business scales. What We're Looking For - 15+ years in the training / EdTech industry. - Experience selling to the Learning & Development department as the primary buyer persona. - 10+ years managing both sales and B2B marketing teams. - A proven, active network of business and personal connections with buyers in the region. - Track record of launching new markets and building regional growth from an early stage. - Deep understanding of the EdTech landscape across Asia. - Full-cycle commercial credibility — able to prospect, close, and lead by example. - Bilingual: Japanese or Chinese fluency. English proficiency is a must.

We're looking for a talented, hands-on design systems designer who is passionate about building the infrastructure great products are made of and wants to change the way people learn languages. You will design and build Cambly's design system as a project: a structured, variable-based token architecture (color, spacing, type, and more) and a documented component library that builds on top of it, with structural support for theming. You'll modernize our existing design system into one that includes clear rules for when and how to use each component, and write specs and documentation precise enough that our designers, our engineers, and our AI coding agents can all implement correctly with minimal ambiguity. You will also be part of a small, fast-moving design team where your work frees up our product designers to focus on the high-craft areas of Lexicon that need it most. Come join us in building the best place to learn and teach English! JOB REQUIREMENTS - Mid-to-senior-level, hands-on design systems expert, with a track record of building and maintaining design systems with tokens, theming, and component libraries in Figma using a variable-based token architecture and provide continuous recommendations that enhance overall velocity and quality - A systems and codification mindset: able to translate design intent into precise, unambiguous rules and documentation that designers, engineers, and AI coding agents can all use. - A strong, well-rounded digital product designer at core — someone whose anchor is design systems work, but who is also a qualified product designer able to contribute beyond systems alone. - Experience (and deep curiosity) working with AI as part of the core development flow. - Self-directed and comfortable operating without a fully perfected process or handoff; this is a fast-moving, still-forming team. - Proven ability to communicate clearly and collaborate with both design and engineering stakeholders. PREFERRED - iOS design experience. - Genuine interest in Cambly's team and mission — there's a real possibility of this expanding into a bigger or longer-term role. — ENGAGEMENT DETAILS - Type: Contract-to-hire. We're hiring for the design system project first; if the contractor proves capable of more than design-system work and is a strong team fit, we'd consider a longer-term or full-time role (not a promise going in). - Length: Roughly 3–5 months, full-time (approximately 40 hrs/week). - Rate: $130–160/hr, depending on experience.

About Cambly: Our mission is to bring high quality English education to every English learner in the world by building a learning platform that optimally combines human tutors and artificial intelligence. By accomplishing our mission, we strive to become the world's largest English language learning marketplace.

We're looking for a talented, hands-on design systems designer who is passionate about building the infrastructure great products are made of and wants to change the way people learn languages. You will design and build Cambly's design system as a project: a structured, variable-based token architecture (color, spacing, type, and more) and a documented component library that builds on top of it, with structural support for theming. You'll modernize our existing design system into one that includes clear rules for when and how to use each component, and write specs and documentation precise enough that our designers, our engineers, and our AI coding agents can all implement correctly with minimal ambiguity. You will also be part of a small, fast-moving design team where your work frees up our product designers to focus on the high-craft areas of Lexicon that need it most.

Come join us in building the best place to learn and teach English!


Job Requirements

  • Mid-to-senior-level, hands-on design systems expert, with a track record of building and maintaining design systems with tokens, theming, and component libraries in Figma using a variable-based token architecture and provide continuous recommendations that enhance overall velocity and quality

  • A systems and codification mindset: able to translate design intent into precise, unambiguous rules and documentation that designers, engineers, and AI coding agents can all use.

  • A strong, well-rounded digital product designer at core — someone whose anchor is design systems work, but who is also a qualified product designer able to contribute beyond systems alone.

  • Experience (and deep curiosity) working with AI as part of the core development flow.

  • Self-directed and comfortable operating without a fully perfected process or handoff; this is a fast-moving, still-forming team.

  • Proven ability to communicate clearly and collaborate with both design and engineering stakeholders.

Preferred

  • iOS design experience.

  • Genuine interest in Cambly's team and mission — there's a real possibility of this expanding into a bigger or longer-term role.

—

Engagement Details

  • Type: Contract-to-hire. We're hiring for the design system project first; if the contractor proves capable of more than design-system work and is a strong team fit, we'd consider a longer-term or full-time role (not a promise going in).

  • Length: Roughly 3–5 months, full-time (approximately 40 hrs/week).

  • Rate: $130–160/hr, depending on experience.
